title: COMP 3522 C++ · Week 4
subtitle: Abstract classes and interfaces, multiple inheritance and the diamond, friends, operator overloading, the copy assignment operator, preparing for Quiz 4 and the midterm
description: Everything in the Week 4 slides and sample projects, taught from scratch: pure virtual functions and abstract classes, interfaces and the virtual destructor, multiple inheritance with its ambiguities, the diamond and virtual base classes with the most-derived-class rule, friend functions and classes, the canonical forms of every overloaded operator, and the copy-and-swap assignment operator. Every program is runnable with its real output; the midterm practice questions are worked; a mock quiz and a cheat sheet close the week.
intro:
:::quiz Quiz 4 scope
Same format as before (multiple choice, true/false, matching, what-does-this-print) at the start of lab. It covers the **Week 4 slides** (both decks) and the **Week 4 sample projects** (Dollar, FriendClass, diamond, diamondmethods, inherit_constructor, oop_abstract, oop_multi0 to oop_multi3, oop_virtual, operators). The slide deck also lists five **midterm practice questions**; they are worked in the second-last lesson.
:::

steps.note: take it cold first, so you know where the gaps are (about 45 min)
pure specifier, what can and cannot be done with an abstract class; play the checker
oop_multi1, 2 and 3 line by line: two grandparents, the lost name, the most derived class
member or non-member, which six comparisons, prefix versus postfix; the rewriter until every expression is obvious
copy-and-swap in four steps; what the compiler's operator= gets wrong
not mutual, not transitive, not inherited, any section
answer the five questions on paper first, then compare
print it and read it on the way in
